# PROCESS — cand_0002 (parent = cand_0001, val 0.450)

Objective = val reward = per-task **DB-match × COMMUNICATE** (db_reward is binary 0/1
per task; mean over 3 trials). To move val I must flip whole tasks (or trials of flaky
tasks) from DB-mismatch to DB-match. This iteration's biggest lever is a new
**`change_cabin` composite WRITE tool** that removes the single most common corruption in
the modify-flow (agent mangles the flights list, or refuses/transfers, on a cabin-only
change), plus targeted policy rules for reservation identification, baggage writes, and
multi-action completion. Reader = mid `gpt-oss-120b` ⇒ code enforcement + literal,
example-bearing docs.

## Ranked cluster list (re-diagnosed from THIS run's ./trajectories/)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | leverage | lever |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Cabin change corrupted / refused | 11, 19, 37, (17,22 cabin part) | agent re-types flights for a cabin-only change and mangles them (19 t2: HAT188 twice), or refuses/transfers because it "can't compute the refund" (11 t1) | CAPABILITY-GAP / BEHAVIORAL | 5 tasks × trials | NEW `change_cabin` tool (code) |
| 2 | Wrong reservation identified | 17 (all trials) | user says "New York→Chicago"; reservation is EWR→ORD; agent treats EWR≠JFK literally + date mismatch → can't find it → transfers | KNOWLEDGE | task 17 hard-zero | policy: city↔airport metro map + match-by-route |
| 3 | Baggage write skipped | 22 t0, 17 | user asks to add free bags; agent says "free, added" but never calls update_reservation_baggages → bag count stays old → DB mismatch | BEHAVIORAL/KNOWLEDGE | 2 tasks | policy: adding bags ALWAYS needs the call, even when free (worked example) |
| 4 | Multi-action abandonment | 37 t2, 23, 17 | one sub-action blocked (flown-segment cancel) → agent transfers and abandons the other VALID actions | BEHAVIORAL | 2–3 tasks | policy: complete every valid action; transfer only the blocked part |
| 5 | "Same flight as before" identification | 8 (flaky) | user wants "the exact flight I took on May 10"; agent schedule-searches + offers a menu → user-sim picks the wrong flight | KNOWLEDGE | task 8 flaky | policy: look the flight up in the user's own reservations |
| — | Multi-booking cheapest-fare + multi-cert split | 23 | needs cheapest-business search + per-booking cert/credit split | SYSTEMIC (hard) | — | SKIPPED (no safe general lever this iter) |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **compose (new tool)** | tools.py `change_cabin(reservation_id, cabin, payment_id)` | Changes ONLY cabin; rebuilds the flights list VERBATIM from the reservation's current segments and delegates to `update_reservation_flights`. Agent cannot pass wrong flights. Runs the flown-segment guard. Returns `payment_summary` with the exact signed charge/refund. | yes — produces identical DB state to the gold's `update_reservation_flights` on the same segments (verified on 11/17/19/22/37) |
| 1 | doc (code) | tools.py `update_reservation_flights` docstring | points cabin-only changes to `change_cabin`; demands verbatim-copied segments, no repeats/invented segments, when segments really change | yes |
| 2 | prompt | policy.md "Match by CITY" | city→airports metro map (NY=JFK/EWR/LGA, Chicago=ORD, …) + "match the route; if exactly one reservation matches the cities, use it even if the stored airport/date differs from what the user said" + worked example | yes — only adds a matching heuristic; never writes a wrong reservation |
| 3 | prompt | policy.md "Change baggage" | adding bags ALWAYS requires `update_reservation_baggages` with the new total, even when all bags are free (saying free≠added); worked example | yes — "do not add bags the user doesn't need" retained |
| 4 | prompt | policy.md "Complete EVERY action" | perform every valid requested action; if one is blocked, still do the others and transfer only the blocked part; worked example | yes |
| 5 | prompt | policy.md "Finding a flight the user took before" | resolve "same flight as last time / took on <date>" from the user's EXISTING reservations, not a fresh schedule search/menu | yes |
| 1 | prompt | policy.md "Change cabin — USE change_cabin" | routes all upgrades/downgrades to `change_cabin`; "never refuse/transfer because you can't compute the amount — the tool computes it"; upgrade + downgrade worked examples | yes |

## Verify-the-fix (live tau2 DB, `/home/skillberry/.cache/capevolve-ci/venv/bin/python`)
- Registration: `get_tools()` returns 15 tools incl. `change_cabin`; `py_compile` clean.
- T11 `change_cabin(GV1N64, basic_economy, gift_card_1642017)`: business→basic_economy, segments HAT003+HAT290 preserved EXACTLY, `payment_summary` = "refunds $5244" (= per-pax diff × 3 pax), payment_history gets the −5244 refund. Matches gold (same flights, basic_economy, refund to gift card) + supplies the COMMUNICATE amount.
- T19 `change_cabin(Z7GOZK, economy, credit_card_9969263)`: keeps HAT188+HAT207 (NOT the mangled HAT188×2 from the failing trial), $218 charge. Fixes trial-2 corruption.
- T17/22 `change_cabin(FQ8APE, economy, gift_card_8190333)`: keeps HAT056+HAT138, $209 charge, cabin economy.
- T37 `change_cabin(M20IZO, business, credit_card_9074831)`: $1194 (= 597×2 pax) — matches gold.
- Same-cabin call → "no price difference", no error (safe no-op). `update_reservation_flights` unchanged and still works.

## Process & features used
- Serial session. Diagnosed every failing/flaky trajectory with a local extractor
  (`trajectories/_dump.py`) that pulls the gold action_checks + a compact transcript, then
  grounded `change_cabin` against the live DB on 5 tasks' real reservations before keeping it.
- Prior iterations read: cand_0001 PROCESS.md + diff.patch (its code guards are all no-op on
  correct inputs and ACCEPTED — I kept them untouched and built the cabin lever on top).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- cand_0001's in-body guards (payment normalize/auto-correct, baggage recompute, cancel-flown)
  — all no-op on correct inputs, ACCEPTED. Untouched.
- Narrow return enrichment (single `payment_summary`); do NOT re-add a wide `communicate_to_user`
  dump (refuted in a prior run).
- `change_cabin` delegates to the existing `update_reservation_flights` body, so it inherits its
  (already-accepted) behavior and the enriched return.

## Dropped-constraint note (system-prompt rule-loss check)
- Removed prose "Cabin class must remain the same across all flights; can't change one segment's
  cabin" — now deterministically enforced: both `change_cabin` and `update_reservation_flights`
  take a single `cabin` applied to the whole reservation, so per-segment cabins are impossible.
- "Kept segments are not re-priced" preserved (reworded) under "Change flights".

## Deliberately skipped
- Task 23 (cancel + 3 business bookings with cheapest-fare search + multi-certificate split):
  needs cheapest-business selection and per-booking cert/credit routing — no safe GENERAL code
  rule; a literal would overfit. Left for a future iteration.
- Task 22 wrong-payment-method trials (used credit card where user said gift card): payment
  choice is the user's; not a safe deterministic guard. The `change_cabin` routing + "state the
  exact amount" may help indirectly; not relied on.
- STALL/###STOP### and the leaked-reasoning infra-noise trials (task 40 t2): uncontrollable per
  instructions.
